---
title: "10: Courts in Authoritarian Regimes"
---

Why do authoritarian rulers build (independent) courts? This week we look at what courts do for authoritarian regimes, such as keeping officials in line, reassuring investors and prosecuting opponents. We also consider how the same courts can apply the law in ordinary cases and defer to the regime in political ones.
